author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch the recording of this session from Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 to dive into the Procedural Content Generation (PCG) and Geometry Scripting frameworks in Unreal Engine, and discover how far they can be pushed when creating procedural city-based tools. 

In this talk, Lucid Games go over a building tool and block processor they have created. Starting from core PCG concepts, their geometry scripting practices, and other technical details, this talk walks through the design and evolution of scalable, artist-friendly systems capable of generating complex, production-ready cities.

Find out more about the PCG framework in Unreal Engine here: dev.epicgames.com/documentation/unreal-engine/procedural-content-generation-overview

#ProceduralContentGeneration, #LucidGames, #GeometryScripting, #ProceduralCities, #UnrealEngine, #UnrealFestChicago2026
title: Procedural Cities for Tech Artists: Geometry Scripting & PCG | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
In September 2025, Immersive Enterprise Laboratories partnered with the Fleet Science Center in San Diego to create The Science of Animation, a three-day pop-up experience that transformed a museum floor into a fully operational, real-time animation studio. 

This session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 takes you behind the scenes of that experience—not as a showcase of finished content, but as an exploration of how animation actually works when art, science, and technology collide in real time. 

Rather than presenting animation as a linear pipeline, the exhibit invited visitors to step directly into the process. Guests designed characters, explored how drawings become 3D models, learned how rigs and facial systems function, performed motion capture, and watched their movements drive animated characters live on screen.
